label: Expression
description: Visible facial expressions, from subtle reactions to strong emotion.
notes: Facial muscle configurations and visible emotion only. Gaze owns viewing direction and eye contact; pose owns head placement and body posture. Excludes enduring facial features, makeup, actions, and inferred personality.
